fact: Communications and ICT Minister Angellah Kairuki said on 18 July 2026 that Tanzania is building a National AI Data Centre, to hold the country's data onshore so Tanzanian and African researchers can train AI systems on it using hydro and geothermal power.

fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab implemented the AI-based alert triage tool now used by Tanzania's Ministry of Health in its event-based surveillance; the document says it uses a rule-based approach with human interaction, with machine learning planned.
